### AmeriServ Account Campaign Supports Area Breast Cancer Awareness Efforts, Patient Needs


November 4, 2026


FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE


Contact:


Susan Tomera Angeletti


SVP - Marketing / Alternative Delivery Services


814-533-5117


AMERISERV ACCOUNT CAMPAIGN SUPPORTS AREA BREAST CANCER AWARENESS EFFORTS, PATIENT NEEDS


Johnstown, PA (NASDAQ: ASRV) – AmeriServ Bank announced today that it has donated $5,000 to the Windber, PA-based Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center as part of its annual October account opening campaign. The donation will help fund the Center’s Pink Ribbon Care, a program that assists patients who are unable to pay for breast-related health services including mammograms, follow-up diagnostic services and genetic counseling.


For every savings or checking account that opened throughout the month of October, AmeriServ pledged to donate $25 to the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center and continue to support the fight against breast cancer. “This is the seventh year that we’ve held the campaign, and the response continues to be tremendous,” Susan Tomera Angeletti, AmeriServ senior vice president – marketing and alternative delivery, said. “Our partnership with the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center is helping people living within our communities gain access to the medical treatment they need. We are honored to work with the Center and to promote the invaluable services they bring to our area.”


Since introducing its account opening campaign in 2020, AmeriServ Bank has donated $35,000 to the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center. Erin Goins, Director of the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center and Director of Ancillary Operations, said “AmeriServ Bank’s generous support of the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center will allow us to provide services to our patients who may normally delay or skip vital appointments due to financial hardship. AmeriServ’s generosity and demonstrated commitment to saving lives in our region cannot be overstated and, on behalf of the Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center and our patients, I can’t thank AmeriServ enough.


In The Photo left to right are:


Top Row: Renee Geibig AmeriServ Branch Leader, Windber Office; Zoie Warynovich, Joyce Murtha Ultrasound Technologist; Renae Handwork, Joyce Murtha Mammography Technologist.


Bottom Row: Erin Goins, Director of Women’s Services; Laura Lovrencic, AmeriServ Branch Leader, Central City Office; Mary Ann Sanna, AVP Retail Service Manager Somerset Office.


**ABOUT THE JOYCE MURTHA BREAST CARE CENTER** – The Joyce Murtha Breast Care Center (JMBCC) opened in February 2002 offering comprehensive and personalized breast care in one convenient location. The JMBCC exists to prevent and treat diseases of the breast and other conditions that can impact the lives of the women served. The tools and techniques used include digital mammography, ultrasound, breast biopsies, breast MRI, bone densitometry, genetic counseling, research studies, and a female breast surgeon on-site.


**ABOUT AMERISERV (ASRV)** - AmeriServ Financial, Inc. is the parent of AmeriServ Financial Bank, located in Johnstown, PA. The bank provides full-service banking and wealth management services through 16 community offices in southwestern Pennsylvania and Hagerstown, Maryland. The Company also operates loan production offices in Altoona and Monroeville, Pennsylvania. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had total assets of $1.45 billion and a book value of $7.18 per common share. AmeriServ Financial, Inc. is publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange under the symbol ASRV.
